query: SELECT a.id,s.created_by snapshot_created_by FROM editorial.review_assignments a JOIN editorial.review_snapshots s ON s.id=$1 AND s.case_id=a.case_id WHERE a.reviewer_id=$2 AND a.status IN ('ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS') AND (a.review_snapshot_id IS NULL OR a.review_snapshot_id=$1) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF a
